C1521.title: Inferno Drainer Exploits EIP-7702 Upgrade for New Phishing Attack
C1521.summary: On May 24, 2025, the wallet-draining service Inferno Drainer was found abusing Ethereum's EIP-7702 in an attack that cost one victim about $150,000. The phishing page induced the user to sign an authorization that delegated an externally owned account to attacker-selected contract logic. Malicious code could then approve token transfers in the background and drain the wallet without displaying each conventional approval separately.
